required_outputs: accepted baseline Run artifact and digest identities
blockers: registry status does not match completed evidence
same mechanism has already been closed without a declared independent distinction

required_outputs: loss decomposition by B02 F05 and P1 P2 P3 path class
month quarter session direction and exposure-state attribution
explicit difference from every relevant closed candidate
expected route to the frozen 2025 H1 gates without candidate-specific 2025 execution
prohibited: starting from a generic parameter grid without a committed mechanism diagnosis
using candidate-specific 2025 H1 outcomes to select mechanism or thresholds

required_metrics: affected positions and affected entry dates by month and quarter
positive negative and zero effect counts
median mean quantiles and maximum absolute effect
net PF target and non-target strategy deltas
activation rate by strategy month quarter and direction

parameter_identifiability.equivalence_definition: same affected trade keys same outcome times and same P/L effects
parameter_identifiability.rule: adjacent or competing parameter cells that are equivalent must be collapsed into one equivalence class before a threshold-specific candidate ID is frozen

automatic_fragility_flags: ex-best-two delta is small relative to total delta
leave-one-month-out minimum is small relative to total delta
one month or date dominates benefit
positive and negative effect counts are nearly balanced
mechanism activation is sparse or highly uneven

required_comparisons: all H1-eligible cells in the family
relevant closed S1 S2 S3 and successor-family mechanisms
required_user_facing_sections: which baseline problem it is intended to solve
what 2025 H1 must confirm if H2 passes

required_preflight: source materialization on the actual runner class
artifact download with explicit repository run_id artifact_id digest and internal path checks
evaluator execution on H1 or synthetic non-holdout evidence
prohibited: ad hoc audit workflows for run discovery
protected-main direct push from a workflow
S5_reusable_mt4_workflow_preflight.technical_failure_rule: after the first technical failure reproduce and correct the exact failure in preflight before another binding-period run

required: research and MT4 affected-trade key parity
exact changed outcome times and P/L parity
B02 or non-target invariance as specified

required_before_h2_dispatch: exact candidate rule thresholds target strategy and processing order
H1 result comparison and fragility report
builder evaluator workflow MQ4 and evidence identities
inert 2025 H1 Rakuten MT4 workflow plan
accepted 2025 H1 baseline identity and evaluator gate contract
explicit H2 PASS unlock and H2 FAIL closure actions
